channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: 2003 was a year of wall-to-wall bangers. If it was belting, we were buying! Forget music trends - nobody was sticking to the rules. Pop was punky, with Busted breaking the mould. Bhangra was funky, as Panjabi MC launched a monster hit with Mundian To Bach Ke - and Jay-Z jumped on with a remix to make yet another hit.
